notes.title: Feb 23 Patch Notes
notes.content: Fixed a bug where skipping the loot reward from PvE encounters would cause game breaking bugs, cause items to expand until they covered the full screen, and generally brick a run. Should now be safe to skip loot!

notes.title: Feb 21st Patch Notes
notes.content:
Balance Changes:
Druidic Altar: When you use a nature item your nature items' cooldown is multiplied by 0.9 -> 0.98.
Flameweave Cloak: Now has tag "Fire".
Frostweave Cloak: Now has tag "Frost".
Battle-steed: At start of combat charge your items 10 seconds -> 4 seconds.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed a bug where Hungry Hippo was not receiving buffs from selling items when in stash.
Fixed a bug where reloading the game would sometimes reset your run to an earlier point in time.
Increased the randomness of the match-making system, so you should now see a more varied pool of opponents.

notes.title: Patch Notes Feb 20th
notes.content:
Balance Changes
Mogul's Blade:
Damage equal to 2x gold -> Damage equal to gold
Cooldown 2 -> 4 seconds.

Wool Trousers: 1.5x max health -> 1.4x max health

Wool Boots: 1.1x max health -> 1.2x max health

Wool Tunic: 1.8x max health -> 1.6x max health

Banner of Glory: Items gain +40 dmg on fight end -> Items gain +30 dmg on fight end.

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where the air elemental NPC monster was causing items to be spawned in the players stash.
Fixed a bug where the shop text pop-up would erroneously display when entering a PvP fight.
Fixed a bug with the PvP match-making system that was causing the you to always fight the same opponent. There should be much more variety in your enemies now!
